### Health Analytics with R · Module 04: Machine Learning for Clinical Prediction
***
**Learning objectives**
- Compare grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimisation (`tune_grid` / `tune_bayes`)
- Implement nested cross-validation for unbiased performance estimation
- Use successive-halving search for efficient large-scale tuning
- Build learning curves to diagnose underfitting and overfitting
- Apply regularisation paths (Ridge, LASSO, ElasticNet logistic regression)

**Estimated time:** 2 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** `tidymodels`, `tune`, `dials`, `ggplot2`

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(glmnet)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"
auc_prob <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")

# Rebuild dataset (same seed)
set.seed(42); N <- 3000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
split <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr <- training(split); df_te <- testing(split)
rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr)
Xtr_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_tr) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xte_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_te) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)
y_tr <- as.integer(as.character(df_tr$readmitted))
y_te <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))
train_baked <- Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr, levels = c(0, 1)))
cat(sprintf("Ready: Train %d x %d, Test %d x %d\n", nrow(Xtr), ncol(Xtr), nrow(Xte), ncol(Xte)))
```

## 2. Grid Search vs Random Search vs Halving

```{r}
# parsnip boost_tree (xgboost) — analogue of GradientBoostingClassifier
xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(), tree_depth = tune(), learn_rate = tune(), sample_size = tune()
) %>% set_engine("xgboost") %>% set_mode("classification")

xgb_wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(xgb_spec) %>% add_formula(readmitted ~ .)
folds3 <- vfold_cv(train_baked, v = 3, strata = readmitted)

# Grid search
grid <- expand_grid(
  trees      = c(100, 200),
  tree_depth = c(4, 6, 8),
  learn_rate = c(0.05, 0.10),
  sample_size = c(0.7, 0.9)
)
t0 <- Sys.time()
gs <- tune_grid(
  xgb_wf, resamples = folds3, grid = grid,
  metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
  control = control_grid(verbose = FALSE)
)
t_grid <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
gs_best <- show_best(gs, metric = "roc_auc", n = 1)
cat(sprintf("Grid search    : %3d configs | best AUC=%.4f | time=%.1fs\n",
            nrow(grid), gs_best$mean, t_grid))

# Random search
set.seed(42)
p_feat <- ncol(Xtr)
rand_param <- extract_parameter_set_dials(xgb_wf) %>%
  update(
    trees      = trees(range = c(50L, 400L)),
    tree_depth = tree_depth(range = c(3L, 10L)),
    learn_rate = learn_rate(range = c(-2, log10(0.3))),
    sample_size = sample_prop(range = c(0.5, 1.0))
  )
t0 <- Sys.time()
rs <- tune_grid(
  xgb_wf, resamples = folds3,
  grid = grid_random(rand_param, size = 30),
  metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
  control = control_grid(verbose = FALSE)
)
t_rand <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
rs_best <- show_best(rs, metric = "roc_auc", n = 1)
cat(sprintf("Random search  :  30 configs | best AUC=%.4f | time=%.1fs\n", rs_best$mean, t_rand))

# Successive halving (factor = 3) on the same grid
# Evaluate all configs on a small subsample, keep top 1/3, expand data, repeat
halving_search <- function(grid, data, factor_h = 3, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(data)
  sizes <- unique(pmin(n, round(n * (factor_h^(0:2)) / (factor_h^2))))
  sizes[length(sizes)] <- n
  remain <- grid
  last_scores <- NULL
  for (s in sizes) {
    idx <- sample.int(n, s)
    sub <- data[idx, ]
    folds_h <- vfold_cv(sub, v = 3, strata = readmitted)
    tun <- tune_grid(
      xgb_wf, resamples = folds_h, grid = remain,
      metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
      control = control_grid(verbose = FALSE)
    )
    ranked <- collect_metrics(tun) %>%
      filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean))
    last_scores <- ranked
    n_keep <- max(1, floor(nrow(ranked) / factor_h))
    keep_cols <- names(remain)
    remain <- ranked %>% select(all_of(keep_cols)) %>% slice_head(n = n_keep)
  }
  last_scores
}
t0 <- Sys.time()
hs <- halving_search(grid, train_baked, factor_h = 3, seed = 42)
t_halv <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
cat(sprintf("Halving grid   : auto reduce | best AUC=%.4f | time=%.1fs\n",
            hs$mean[1], t_halv))
cat(sprintf(" Halving speedup vs grid search: %.1f×\n", t_grid / max(t_halv, 0.01)))
```

## 3. Nested Cross-Validation — Unbiased Evaluation

```{r}
# Nested CV: inner loop tunes hyperparams, outer loop evaluates generalisation
# This avoids the optimistic bias of tuning and evaluating on the same data
set.seed(42)
outer_cv <- vfold_cv(train_baked, v = 5, strata = readmitted)
param_grid_small <- expand_grid(
  trees = c(100, 200), tree_depth = c(4, 6),
  learn_rate = c(0.05, 0.10), sample_size = 0.8
)

nested_auc <- map_dbl(seq_along(outer_cv$splits), function(fold) {
  sp <- outer_cv$splits[[fold]]
  d_in  <- analysis(sp)
  d_out <- assessment(sp)
  inner <- vfold_cv(d_in, v = 3, strata = readmitted)
  gs_inner <- tune_grid(
    xgb_wf, resamples = inner, grid = param_grid_small,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
    control = control_grid(verbose = FALSE)
  )
  best <- select_best(gs_inner, metric = "roc_auc")
  fit  <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf, best) %>% fit(d_in)
  p    <- predict(fit, new_data = d_out, type = "prob")$.pred_1
  auc_out <- auc_prob(as.integer(as.character(d_out$readmitted)), p)
  cat(sprintf("  Outer fold %d: best_params=%s | AUC=%.4f\n",
              fold, paste(names(best), best, sep = "=", collapse = ", "), auc_out))
  auc_out
})

cat(sprintf(" Nested CV AUC: %.4f ± %.4f\n", mean(nested_auc), sd(nested_auc)))
cat(sprintf("Non-nested (grid search, same data): %.4f\n", gs_best$mean))
cat(sprintf("Optimism bias: %+.4f\n", gs_best$mean - mean(nested_auc)))
```

## 4. Learning Curves

```{r}
best_params <- select_best(gs, metric = "roc_auc")
best_wf <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf, best_params)

train_fracs <- seq(0.10, 1.0, length.out = 10)
lc <- map_dfr(train_fracs, function(frac) {
  set.seed(42)
  n_use <- max(50, floor(frac * nrow(train_baked)))
  folds_lc <- vfold_cv(train_baked, v = 3, strata = readmitted)
  scores <- map(folds_lc$splits, function(sp) {
    tr <- analysis(sp)
    te <- assessment(sp)
    tr <- tr[sample.int(nrow(tr), min(n_use, nrow(tr))), ]
    fit <- best_wf %>% fit(tr)
    p_tr <- predict(fit, new_data = tr, type = "prob")$.pred_1
    p_te <- predict(fit, new_data = te, type = "prob")$.pred_1
    tibble(
      train = auc_prob(as.integer(as.character(tr$readmitted)), p_tr),
      val   = auc_prob(as.integer(as.character(te$readmitted)), p_te)
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  tibble(
    n = n_use,
    train_mean = mean(scores$train), train_sd = sd(scores$train),
    val_mean   = mean(scores$val),   val_sd   = sd(scores$val)
  )
})

gap <- lc$train_mean[nrow(lc)] - lc$val_mean[nrow(lc)]
ggplot(lc, aes(n)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = train_mean - train_sd, ymax = train_mean + train_sd),
              fill = col_red, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = val_mean - val_sd, ymax = val_mean + val_sd),
              fill = col_blue, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_mean, colour = "Train AUC"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = train_mean, colour = "Train AUC"), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = val_mean, colour = "CV Val AUC"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = val_mean, colour = "CV Val AUC"), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Train AUC" = col_red, "CV Val AUC" = col_blue)) +
  annotate("text", x = min(lc$n), y = 0.55,
           label = sprintf("Train-val gap at N=%.0f: %.3f", lc$n[nrow(lc)], gap),
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "Training set size", y = "AUC-ROC", colour = NULL,
       title = "Learning curves — diagnosis of over/underfitting")
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "learning_curves.png"), width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 120)
cat("Diagnosing learning curves:\n")
cat("  Large gap (train >> val) → overfitting → increase regularisation or reduce complexity\n")
cat("  Both curves low          → underfitting → add features, reduce regularisation, or use a more complex model\n")
cat("  Curves converge          → more data won't help; focus on feature engineering\n")
```

## 5. Regularisation Paths for Logistic Regression

```{r}
Cs <- 10^seq(-4, 4, length.out = 30)
# glmnet lambda is inverse of C (inverse regularisation strength); use lambda = 1/C
path <- map_dfr(Cs, function(C) {
  lam <- 1 / C
  w <- ifelse(y_tr == 1, 0.5 / mean(y_tr == 1), 0.5 / mean(y_tr == 0))
  fit <- glmnet(Xtr, y_tr, family = "binomial", alpha = 0, lambda = lam, weights = w)
  p_tr <- as.numeric(predict(fit, Xtr, type = "response"))
  p_te <- as.numeric(predict(fit, Xte, type = "response"))
  tibble(C = C, train = auc_prob(y_tr, p_tr), test = auc_prob(y_te, p_te))
})
best_C <- path$C[which.max(path$test)]

ggplot(path, aes(C)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train, colour = "Train AUC"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = test,  colour = "Test AUC"),  linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_C, colour = col_green, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = min(Cs), xmax = 1e-1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.05, fill = col_blue) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1e2, xmax = max(Cs), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.05, fill = col_red) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Train AUC" = col_red, "Test AUC" = col_blue)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 0.90)) +
  labs(x = "C (inverse regularisation strength)", y = "AUC-ROC", colour = NULL,
       title = "Regularisation path — Logistic Regression")
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "reg_path.png"), width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 120)
cat(sprintf("Best C: %.4f | Best test AUC: %.4f\n", best_C, max(path$test)))
```

## 6. Knowledge Check
1. Nested CV AUC = 0.76 but standard CV AUC = 0.79. What does the 0.03 gap represent?
2. Your learning curves show train AUC=0.91 and val AUC=0.74 at N=2000. What should you do?
3. A very small C (say 0.001) in logistic regression leads to what kind of bias-variance problem?
4. HalvingGridSearch allocated more budget to promising configurations. Explain this mechanism in two sentences.
5. Re-run nested CV using Random Forest instead of GBM. Does the optimism bias increase or decrease?

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — nested CV with RF
set.seed(42)
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = tune(), min_n = tune(), mtry = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE) %>% set_mode("classification")
rf_wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(rf_spec) %>% add_formula(readmitted ~ .)
pg_rf <- expand_grid(
  trees = c(100, 200), min_n = c(5, 15),
  mtry = c(max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(Xtr)))), max(1, floor(log2(ncol(Xtr)))))
)

rf_nested_auc <- map_dbl(seq_along(outer_cv$splits), function(fold) {
  sp <- outer_cv$splits[[fold]]
  d_in <- analysis(sp); d_out <- assessment(sp)
  inner <- vfold_cv(d_in, v = 3, strata = readmitted)
  gs_rf <- tune_grid(rf_wf, resamples = inner, grid = pg_rf,
                     metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
                     control = control_grid(verbose = FALSE))
  fit <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, select_best(gs_rf, metric = "roc_auc")) %>% fit(d_in)
  p <- predict(fit, new_data = d_out, type = "prob")$.pred_1
  auc_prob(as.integer(as.character(d_out$readmitted)), p)
})
cat(sprintf("RF Nested CV : %.4f ± %.4f\n", mean(rf_nested_auc), sd(rf_nested_auc)))
cat(sprintf("GB Nested CV : %.4f ± %.4f\n", mean(nested_auc), sd(nested_auc)))
```
